text: Dedicated exhibition space for Vietnamese products set to open in Malaysia
HÀ NỘI - A dedicated exhibition space at the Vietnam Trade Office in Malaysia showcasing Vietnamese products is expected to be completed early next month.

To support Vietnamese exporters and help Vietnamese goods gain wider access to the Malaysian market, the trade office has worked to build a dedicated exhibition area for Vietnamese product samples at its office.

"Although the space is relatively modest due to limitations in area and resources, we hope that the exhibition zone will help meet, to some extent, businesses' needs for product promotion," said Phùng Văn Thành, trade counsellor at the Vietnam Trade Office in Malaysia, in an interview with Mekong ASEAN online magazine.
Regarding future plans, Thành said that the trade office intends to organise a monthly programme titled 'MiniConference - Coffee Talk - B2B Matching' next year.
A display area featuring high-quality Vietnamese products will serve as a key highlight of the programme, helping promote Vietnamese goods and attract potential business partners.
In addition, a product sampling area will be set up adjacent to the exhibition space, allowing guests to sample the products and assess their quality and taste.
The trade office will also provide a dedicated meeting area for businesses to meet, exchange information and connect with potential business partners. - VNS
